name: dev-setup
description: AI-native setup for software development projects

TRACKER_PROVIDER.title: Task tracker
TRACKER_PROVIDER.description: The task tracker the projects use: clickup, linear or none. A project's .claude/tracker.json wins over it

CLICKUP_SETUP_LIST_ID.title: ClickUp Sprint List ID
CLICKUP_SETUP_LIST_ID.description: ClickUp list id for the sprint tasks (find it in the URL: app.clickup.com/.../li/<ID>). Still honoured: with no tracker chosen, it means ClickUp with this list

TRACKER_LIST_ID.title: Task list
TRACKER_LIST_ID.description: Where the tasks are read from: a ClickUp list id (app.clickup.com/.../li/<ID>) or a Linear team key (ENG)
